title: Orientation & Foundation
description:
Week 0 served as the orientation and foundation phase of PRICE ProtoSem, introducing participants to the programme structure and to one another before the 20-week retail problem-solving journey began.

Day 1: The week opened with introductions - to fellow participants, the programme itself, and what would be expected over the coming weeks. This was followed by icebreaker activities designed to help everyone get comfortable with the group.

Day 2: Sessions covered building a professional presence on LinkedIn, a self-understanding exercise through the 16Personalities assessment, and short story presentations that encouraged creativity and communication.

Day 3: Story presentations continued, alongside an ITEC TechTalk. The day also included team-based activities - Imposter, Challenge, and Marshmello - aimed at building interaction, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

Day 4: Featured a TechTalk on the Art of Prompting, an orientation covering the programme roadmap and what lay ahead, an introduction to the leaderboard system, and the official inauguration of ProtoSem.

Beta Teams: For Week 0, participants were grouped into temporary "Beta Teams." Working with a different set of people gave everyone a chance to interact, collaborate, and experience teamwork before permanent team structures were set.

Friday - Entrepreneurship Day: The morning featured a session led by an industry expert, followed by an afternoon reflection session where participants reviewed the week's activities and takeaways.

Overall, Week 0 functioned as a foundation-building week - helping participants connect with each other, understand the programme, explore different skills, and prepare for the real-world retail challenges ahead.

title: From Understanding the Industry to Understanding How to Think About It
description:
Day 1 - Looking at the industry differently:
We explored Instagram's recommendation algorithm and a Design Thinking activity that encouraged us to approach problems from different perspectives. We also studied the evolution of a retail sector, with our team choosing the mobile sector for further exploration.

Day 2 - Understanding the sector:
We learned to create a Power BI dashboard and explored why our chosen sector matters. We then analysed the mobile retail sector through its value chain and SWOT analysis.

Day 3 - A pause to process:
A break from the structured sessions gave us time to reflect and build on what we had explored so far.

Day 4 - Behaviour, technology and professional presence:
We were introduced to Prospect Theory and explored digital portfolios using Antigravity, GitHub, and Vercel, connecting technology with our professional identity.

Day 5 - Exploring AI and new industries:
We explored Base44 as an AI app-building tool and discussed the importance of goals and vision. We also gained exposure to the agriculture and textile sectors, broadening our perspective beyond mobile retail.

Week 1 Takeaway:
Week 1 brought together industry understanding, design thinking, data, technology, and decision-making - helping us see that understanding the problem comes before building the solution.
